messages.author: d60841a556930341
messages.subject: Annotation file not supported
parts:
Hi,

I was trying to use Arabidopsis annotation file downloaded from http://www.igbquickload.org/quickload/A_thaliana_Jun_2009/ and tried both TAIR10.bed and TAIR10_mRNA.bed. I got following error message. 


> gene.obj = read.transcript.features("TAIR10_mRNA.bed")
Error in scan(file, what, nmax, sep, dec, quote, skip, nlines, na.strings,  : 
  line 2 did not have 18 elements
> gene.obj = read.transcript.features("TAIR10.bed.txt")
Error in scan(file, what, nmax, sep, dec, quote, skip, nlines, na.strings,  : 
  line 2 did not have 18 elements


Could you suggest me how can I solve this problem? Or, do you happen to know where can I find a working bed file for TAIR10 assembly?



Thanks in advance.

Rishi

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: Annotation file not supported
parts:
These files do not look like proper bed files. Try removing the last two columns and if you need more info about BED file format check specification from UCSC genome browser.

Best,
Altuna
